name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2025 in Intrusions (ICS)
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK for ICS techniques from the 2025 record: the behaviors CISA's AA25-343A describes for pro-Russia hacktivists reaching operational technology through minimally secured internet-facing VNC, with ids assigned by the study. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2025.md. Scores: 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id.
